name: portal-carousel
title: Portal Carousel
description: Fullscreen carousel where a cursor-following preview expands into the next image on click.

props.name: images
props.description: Images shown in order and looping: { src, alt?, title? }. Needs at least two.

props.name: label
props.description: Text on the tag that sits at the cursor.

props.name: thumbWidth
props.description: Size of the square preview, in px. Capped at 42vw.

props.name: followSpeed
props.description: How quickly the preview chases the cursor, from 0.02 (lazy) to 1 (locked on).

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for the preview to expand to fullscreen, in seconds.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the carousel root.
